# rbingood

> rbingood is a platform where companies sponsor or join environmental cleanup events and receive a verified ESG Data Pack — GPS tracks, timestamped photos, waste weight data — audit-ready for CSRD / ESRS S3 reporting. Participants earn €10 per event. Cities get cleaner.

## Pages

- [Home](https://rbingood.com/): Community platform for sponsored environmental cleanups in Portugal. Explains how events work, what participants earn, what sponsors receive, and how to join.
- [For Business](https://rbingood.com/sponsor.html): B2B page. ESG Data Pack for companies, corporate team cleanup events, CSRD compliance packages. Pricing from €500.
- [Events](https://rbingood.com/event.html): Map and list of upcoming and completed cleanup events with registration.

## Key Facts

- Founded by Ksenia Em and Kate Mikholap
- Based in Lisbon, Portugal
- 18 cleanup events completed
- 2,600+ kg of waste collected
- 400+ community members
- 7 sponsored events
- Languages: English (default), Russian, Portuguese

## How It Works

1. A company sponsors a cleanup event
2. Participants register on the platform and show up
3. Cleanup lasts approximately 2 hours
4. All actions are documented: GPS tracks, timestamped photos, waste weight
5. Participants receive €10, sponsors receive an ESG Data Pack (PDF report + CSV + evidence folder)

## ESG Data Pack

The ESG Data Pack is rbingood's core product for businesses. It contains:
- GPS-verified location and route data
- Timestamped before/after photos
- Waste weight measurement (kg)
- Participant count and demographics
- ESRS E5 / S3 compliant structured data
- Audit-ready PDF report + raw CSV

## For Participants

- Earn €10 per sponsored cleanup (~2 hours)
- Payment within 3–5 business days
- Flexible schedule — choose events that fit your location
- All equipment provided (gloves, bags, grabbers)
- No experience needed

## For Business Sponsors

- Verified ESG evidence for CSRD reporting (ESRS S3)
- Corporate team building events with real environmental impact
- Brand visibility at events
- Pricing: Pilot €500 (1 event + sample Data Pack), Standard €2,600/year (4 events + full Data Pack), Enterprise — custom

## For Local Businesses

- Barter partnership (water, snacks, coffee for participants)
- Community visibility and goodwill

## What rbingood is NOT

- Not a donation platform
- Not greenwashing — all data is GPS-verified, photo-documented, and weight-measured
- Not a traditional CSR program — provides audit-ready evidence, not just storytelling
